architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

consumed_events.name: VrpConsentGranted
consumed_events.purpose: Update Open Banking API response to PISP with active consent_id and access token

consumed_events.name: VrpConsentRevoked
consumed_events.purpose: Update consent management dashboard to reflect revoked status

design_decisions: SVC-017 acts as Open Banking API gateway/channel for TPP interactions and customer consent portal. It does not own consent data — that is SVC-009's domain.
SVC-017 calls SVC-100 (IAM, same-capability platform service) for TPP token validation and customer SCA — intra-capability.
SVC-009 owns VrpConsent (ENT-070) and VrpPayment (ENT-071) as payment domain entities.

SVC-009 receives VRP consent creation and payment execution requests from SVC-017 (Digital Channels) via internal sync calls — SVC-017 is the API surface (CAP-007 boundary), SVC-009 processes the domain logic (CAP-003 boundary).
SVC-009 calls SVC-013 (Fraud Detection, CAP-004) via async event pattern — publishes payment intent, receives fraud score result.
SVC-009 calls SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001) via EVT-157 for balance update on source account — async.

consumed_events.name: VrpPaymentExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: Post-execution fraud model update — train on VRP payment behaviour patterns

design_decisions: Fraud scoring for VRP payments is a synchronous internal call from SVC-009 to SVC-013 within their respective capabilities — cross-capability boundary requires the request to flow via event. SVC-009 publishes a VrpPaymentFraudCheckRequested event (internal to PH-117 processing); SVC-013 responds with fraud score. This is modelled as a sync call within the payment execution flow for latency reasons per DD-029-02.

consumed_events.name: VrpPaymentExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: Debit source account; update account transaction history

consumed_events.name: VrpConsentGranted
consumed_events.purpose: Send consent confirmation notification to customer

consumed_events.name: VrpPaymentExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: Send payment confirmation notification to customer (optional per customer preferences)

consumed_events.name: VrpConsentRevoked
consumed_events.purpose: Send revocation confirmation to customer and PISP webhook callback

consumed_events.name: VrpConsentGranted
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable consent grant record (SCA assertion ref, parameters, timestamp)

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-017 (CAP-007) → SVC-009 (CAP-003): VRP consent creation and payment execution requests — internal sync via capability boundary (Channel → Capability API pattern)
SVC-009 (CAP-003) → SVC-013 (CAP-004): Fraud scoring for VRP payment — real-time inline call for latency reasons (within payment execution critical path)
SVC-009 (CAP-003) → EVT-156/157/158 → SVC-001 (CAP-001), SVC-053 (CAP-007), SVC-103 (CAP-008): All post-processing async via Event Bus
